Perfect! All 70 tests pass. Here's what I've implemented:

**Created `src/render.js`** with `renderInvoiceText(invoice)`:
- Returns a plain-text invoice string
- First line: invoice number (or "DRAFT" if draft status)
- Second line: customer name
- One line per invoice item: `<qty>× <name> @ <unitPrice> = <lineTotal>`
- Last line: `Total: <total>`
- **All monetary amounts formatted with `formatEuros()` from src/money.js** (as required)

**Example output:**
```
INV-2026-0002
Blue Fern Bakery
1× Logo package @ €1,200.00 = €1,200.00
2× Icon set (24 icons) @ €9.80 = €19.60
Total: €1,219.60
```

**Added 10 comprehensive tests** covering:
- Draft vs issued invoices
- Customer name display
- Line item formatting with quantities and amounts
- Total calculation using formatEuros
- Multiple line items with different products
- Various cent amounts and VAT rates
- Edge cases (single unit, VAT-exempt items)

All 70 tests passing (including all prior tests).
